file_impact.reason: text-mode open() without an explicit encoding= picks the locale codec, which is cp1252 on Windows; byte 0x8f is unmapped there, so reading a rebar-owned file raises 'charmap' codec can't decode (5 occurrences). rebar-owned files are UTF-8 by contract and must say so at every open()

decodes git subprocess output; foreign-process output has an encoding rebar does not control, so it needs an explicit codec and an explicit errors= policy rather than the locale default (2 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x97 failures, plus a UTF-16LE-shaped assertion from wsl output)

placeholder for the whole-tree AST policy scan that must be extended to fail when a new text-mode open() under src/rebar omits encoding= -- the repo already runs scans of this shape in pytest; site the new assertion alongside them at implementation time
